clips.title: 杰克·保罗联手PFL，挑战UFC霸主地位

subtitles.en: We are here with the latest deal in the world of sports and involves a mashup of most valuable promotions.
subtitles.zh: 今天我们带来体育界的最新交易，涉及MVP的合并。

subtitles.en: Of course, the promotional and fighting company founded by Jake Paul and Nikesa Bajarian as well as PFL, the professional fighters.
subtitles.zh: 当然，这是由杰克·保罗和尼凯萨·巴贾里安创立的推广和格斗公司，以及PFLPFL。

subtitles.en: League John, great to have you back on the program as well. You now are all partners combining forces.
subtitles.zh: 约翰，欢迎回到节目。你们现在都是合作伙伴，强强联手。

subtitles.en: Why? Yeah, I think there's like a massive gap in Emma May right now.
subtitles.zh: 为什么？我觉得现在格斗市场存在巨大的空白。

subtitles.en: I feel like the culture is different.
And there's just so much space to take over. We've proven that with our partnerships with Netflix and putting on the Rousey Carano fight.
subtitles.zh: 而且有太多空间可以占领。我们与Netflix的合作以及举办隆达·罗西对卡兰诺的比赛已经证明了这一点。

subtitles.en: The demand that's there for our events and the events that we put on on a consistent basis.
subtitles.zh: 我们的赛事以及我们持续举办的活动都有需求。

subtitles.en: And fighters are being treated unfairly in other organizations.
subtitles.zh: 而其他组织中的拳手待遇不公。

subtitles.en: I'm sure people will know like who I'm talking about but we've always had the ethos of fighter first. And so giving them the best place, the best destination,
subtitles.zh: 我相信人们知道我说的是谁，但我们一直秉持拳手至上的理念。所以给他们最好的地方，最好的目的地，

subtitles.en: making sure that they're paid appropriately and have all the benefits and can still gain the same amount of viewership from the events that we put on.
subtitles.zh: 确保他们获得合理的报酬和所有福利，并且仍然能从我们举办的赛事中获得同样的观众量。

subtitles.en: It's just another home that is needed. It's very badly needed.
subtitles.zh: 这只是另一个急需的住所。

subtitles.en: So there's a problem and a solution and that's us.
subtitles.zh: 所以有问题就有解决方案，而我们就是解决方案。

subtitles.en: And that's really all entrepreneurship comes down to its fixing problems.
subtitles.zh: 创业的本质就是解决问题。

subtitles.en: Give me a sense though of how that structure is going to look overall.
subtitles.zh: 不过请让我了解一下整体结构会是什么样子。
